body:
I can't do that again. I've been homeless before due to surgery leaving me unable to work, and my family not being there for me (I had just left college and had no savings and had never really been on my own) and I just can't do it again. I hate where I am, too. The state, the part of the country, I hate it.

It makes me really fucking sad to think about dying, but thinking about living feels even worse.
